description: Saves an image from a link or an Unsplash photo as a team image asset. Use when the user picks a cover image or wants their own image available as a cover. Not for finding photos (use search_stock_images). Returns the image asset ID, usable as a cover image ID, and a thumbnail.

unsplash_photo_id.description: Unsplash photo ID from search_stock_images, e.g. "Dwu85P9SOIk". Use instead of url.

url.description: Public link to a JPG, PNG or WebP image, e.g. "https://example.com/cover.jpg". Use instead of unsplash_photo_id.

name: import_image
title: Import image
